name: DSLO v0.7 — Semantic Substrate Specification
description: Manifest describing all surfaces included in the DSLO v0.7 repository. This manifest documents human-authored specification surfaces, compiled semantic surfaces, glossary, ontology, taxonomy, registry, schema, and supporting materials. Folder structure is preserved exactly as present in the GitHub repository.

specification.description: Human-authored DSLO v0.7 conceptual surfaces, including geometry, manifold definitions, operator descriptions, runtime geometry, and thermodynamic extensions.

glossary.description: DSLO v0.7 glossary, including machine-readable JSON, human-readable Markdown, and graph representations.

ontology.description: Compiled DSLO v0.7 ontology surfaces generated from the substrate.

schema.description: DSLO v0.7 schema surfaces defining structural rules for ontology, taxonomy, registry, and glossary.

examples.description: Optional human-authored examples demonstrating DSLO concepts. Included for completeness.

metadata.description: Metadata surfaces for scientific indexing, citation, and cross-surface alignment.
